title: Animal Cruelty Case Specialist
description:
Description

Term of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To: Criminal Justice Program Managing Attorney

Union: Bargaining Unit Position, Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU)

Location: Remote (U.S. Based)

Who We Are

The Animal Legal Defense Fundâs mission is to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system. The Animal Legal Defense Fund accomplishes this mission by filing high-impact lawsuits to protect animals from harm, providing free legal assistance and training to prosecutors to assure that animal abusers are held accountable for their crimes, supporting tough animal protection legislation and fighting legislation harmful to animals, gathering data about and advocating for effective regulation of animal exploitative industries and providing resources and opportunities to law students and professionals to advance the emerging field of animal law.

Role Description

The Criminal Justice Program (CJP) Animal Cruelty Case Specialist position furthers the mission of the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system, by providing prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues with essential operational and forensic support on criminal animal cruelty cases and encouraging the investigation and prosecution of animal crimes to ensure justice for animal victims. The CJP Animal Cruelty Case Specialist triages all incoming reports of animal cruelty and maintains the active case database. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist applies their experience and expertise to in-depth case-related research and to the training of key stakeholders. This position acts as a liaison across ALDFâs programs to disseminate approved case response information in a timely and responsible manner. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist is accountable for the day-to-day management of their assigned cases and projects.

How You Will Make a Difference

Case Support

  • Receive reports of animal cruelty and requests for case assistance from professional stakeholders, the Administrative Manager, and other sources. Provide initial responses and triage via phone or email.
  • Exercise discretion in analyzing and recommending which cases CJP chooses to pursue, including communicating efficiently with complainants and advocates by phone and email; gathering relevant facts (through eyewitness accounts, media reports, and other sources as needed) for potential criminal cruelty cases; and identifying, after thorough independent analysis, those cases warranting further investigation and/or veterinary forensics.
  • Generate and categorize cases, and work with Managing Attorneys to assign cases to CJP staff according to department protocols. Ensure that complete and accurate case information is relayed in a timely fashion to the appropriate team members.
  • Input and access information using automated systems, make entries into automated record files, seek to maximize use of automated systems available to CJP to further efficiency and accuracy in case response and record keeping.
  • Maintain and organize all case-related records and documentation in a timely, logical, and confidential manner. Ensure that electronic logs of all legal cases are accurate and current. Review case notes to maintain consistent and timely response in all cases.
  • Conduct internet research on potential/active cases (i.e. Facebook, social media, news sources, and company websites). Provide basic assistance in research projects, special reports, and case information gathering. Prepare materials for meetings, court proceedings, and case discovery.
  • Follow up with professional stakeholders on case outcomes/resolutions where possible. Create and maintain a system for tracking date and time of upcoming court proceedings related to CJP-assisted cases.
  • Manage CJP grant processing for expert witnesses, forensic testing, and costs of care in criminal cases, coordinating with internal and external individuals as needed.
  • Inform and assist law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues on animal cruelty case investigations and case strategies, including reviewing and advising on interview tactics, department policies and procedures, veterinary exams and reports, protective custody foster care programs and related agreements, and large-scale animal rescue implementation.
  • Participate in deployment to crime scenes and rescues as needed, exercising discretion in both the decision to travel on-site and the orchestration of such activities.
  • Assist with hands-on scene processing for animal cruelty cases, including identifying, collecting and packaging evidence; assisting with logistics and operational expertise; and assisting with other aspects of search and seizure operations and animal rescue support.
  • Provide support as requested to CJP Case Response Unit.

External Relationship Building and Outreach

  • Build strategic relationships with prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues to facilitate agency assistance in forensics, crime scene processing, and veterinary medicine.
  • Schedule and conduct outreach and training presentations for various disciplines, including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, veterinarians, prosecutors, animal shelters and rescues, and social service agencies.

Internal Relationship Building

  • Proactively maintain intradepartmental relationships and act as a liaison to other programs.
  • Create and maintain system for sharing information about CJP case work and outcomes across departments and facilitate the sharing of information approved for public-facing materials.
  • Provide in-house expertise for staff on questions concerning Criminal Justice Program cases, animal cruelty cases in general, criminal investigation, veterinary forensics, animal rescue and sheltering.

Please note, this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, which are subject to change in order to best advance ALDFâs strategic objectives and mission.

Requirements

We Are Looking for Candidates With:

  • A bachelorâs degree in a related field desired; or 5 years equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of.
  • At least 3 years of experience in enforcement fieldwork operations, animal cruelty response, dispatch, and/or criminal case management.
  • Demonstrated veterinary forensics or animal cruelty enforcement expertise, including but not limited to, retaining related certifications in the field (such as Certificate in Veterinary Forensics, NACA certifications, FEMA certification, Property and Evidence Certifications, Police or Humane Officer certification).
  • The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and materials according to the highest standards of confidentiality, chain of custody, and ethical conduct and exercise discretion in the use of related materials and information.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, organizational members and supporters, members of the public, and others. A positive attitude, ability to work cooperatively with others, and ability to function well in a team-oriented work environment.
  • Comfort speaking in public to audiences of various sizes and demographics.
  • The ability to maintain composure and lead others in times of heightened urgency or stress.
  • An understanding of and full commitment to the vision, mission, and core values of the Animal Legal Defense Fund.
  • The ability to travel frequently to conferences, trainings, meetings, and other events as required; estimated 5-7 events per year.

We Offer Competitive Compensation With Excellent Benefits, Including

  • Starting annual salary of $71,509 for most geographic locations.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of Washington D.C., Cotati, CA, and Los Angeles, starting pay is $75,273.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of New York City and San Francisco, starting pay is $79,036.

To ensure salary equity, we do not negotiate salary outside of the published starting rate. Rate is determined by role, using set geographical factors.

  • Comprehensive health care, dental, life and vision benefits (100% employer paid); Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Account (DCA) are also available
  • 192 hours of PTO
  • 19 paid holidays
  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of continuous employment
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • 401k plan with a maximum 5% employer contribution match after one year of employment
  • Alternative work schedules (at managerâs discretion)
  • One-time remote work allowance of $750
  • Annual professional development reimbursement of up to $1,000.

Maintaining a healthy work/life balance is a core value for the Animal Legal Defense Fund.

Additional Information

This role is included in a collective bargaining unit that is represented by the Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU). Certain terms and conditions of your employment, including wages and benefits, have been negotiated with the Union and are included in a collective bargaining agreement between ALDF and the Union.

This is a U.S. based position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

title: Merchandising Operations Manager
description:
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

Merchandising Operations Manager

Grove's merchandising operation is full of good instincts running on manual work. This role exists to fix that: redesign the core processes, then personally build the automation that makes them stick. This is a rare shot at rebuilding how merchandising actually runs, and at proving AI belongs in the hands of the person closest to the problem, not just the AI team.

We're not hiring someone to write a strategy memo about AI and hand it off. We're hiring someone who will map the workflow, feel where it breaks, and then sit down and build the thing that fixes it.

More About the Opportunity

  • Merchandising at Grove runs on real expertise and too much manual glue.
  • Buyers chase vendors for the same data, week after week.
  • Marketing launches promotions inventory finds out about too late.
  • Good people spend their time on work a workflow should be doing for them.
  • We have an internal AI team. They coach. They don't build for you.
  • This role is for the person who wants their hands on the keyboard, not the person who scopes it and waits.
  • The honest version: no template here. You're defining the standard as you go, with review at key milestones and real autonomy in between.
  • Some of what you build will work on the first try. Some won't. That's the job.

What You'll Own

  • Map how merchandising actually works today, not how the org chart says it works.
  • Redesign core operating processes for speed, accuracy, and margin protection: assortment planning, item setup, pricing and markdown, vendor and PO management, allocation, replenishment.
  • Own the calendar connecting marketing activations to inventory, so launches are stock-backed, not a surprise to the warehouse.
  • Translate activation plans into buy, allocation, and replenishment signals; flag stock risk before launch, not after.
  • Coordinate vendor commitments tied to activations: fill rates, lead times, launch quantities.
  • Build self-service tools and proactive alerts that scale the buyer-vendor relationship, including visibility into vendor performance.
  • Build the automation yourself, using Claude and comparable AI tools, no/low-code platforms, and lightweight automation, from concept through rollout.
  • Run pilots end to end: scope, build, test for accuracy, validate fit, scale. Keep humans in the loop on margin- and inventory-critical decisions.
  • Maintain a registry of approved tools and active automations, so what exists and what it's for is never a mystery.
  • Own change management for every rollout: training, AI literacy for non-technical audiences, office hours, a bench of power users.
  • Build reporting on process and automation performance, and use it to prioritize what gets built next.

About You

  • Real fluency in retail merchandising operations, not an adjacent function you've watched from a distance.
  • You've mapped a broken process and redesigned it, not just diagnosed it.
  • Basic technical acumen and a genuine willingness to build, no engineering background required.
  • Comfortable working with a specialist team as a coaching resource, not a build team, and taking their guidance without handing off your job.
  • You've run a pilot from scoping through adoption, and you know the gap between a demo and something people actually use.
  • You care about the boring, durable stuff: documentation, SOPs, registries, training, the things that outlast the person who built them.
  • You think in workflows and root causes, not tickets.
  • You know the difference between a problem worth automating and one worth leaving alone.

Even Better if You Have

  • Built something with Claude or a comparable AI tool that a non-technical team now relies on.
  • Experience connecting marketing or demand planning to inventory and allocation.
  • Designed a self-service tool that measurably cut manual buyer-vendor back-and-forth.
  • A retail, CPG, or commerce background with real fluency in vendor and marketplace dynamics.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts.
  • Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental
  • Equity - shared success is core to our mission
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - we care most about results
  • Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount
  • Working for a company that believes that a small group of people can change the world for the better by creating products and funding initiatives that help the planet!

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $135,000-165,000. Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country. In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for an annual incentive target and equity.

MORE ABOUT GROVE

Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Explore thousands of thoughtfully vetted products for every room and everyone in your home, including household cleaning, personal care, health and wellness, laundry, clean beauty, kitchen, pantry, kids, baby, pet care, and beyond. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard â from health to sustainability and performance â so you get a great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, Grove goes beyond selling products: every order is carbon neutral, supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives, and lets you see and track the positive impact of your choices. Shopping with purpose starts at Grove.com.

We're building a diverse and inclusive work environment where we learn from each other. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to Talent@grove.co.

For information on our privacy policy, visit this link on our website.

description:
Benefits:

  • Health insurance

About UFC GYM

UFC GYM is the first major brand extension of UFC, the world's premier mixed martial arts organization. As the pioneer of MMA-inspired fitness, UFC GYM offers members access to world-class training programs, group fitness classes, personal and small-group training, and youth programming across corporate and franchise locations worldwide. Our brand lives at the intersection of combat sports, fitness, and community and our marketing team brings that energy to life every day.

Position Overview

UFC GYM is seeking a Junior Designer to join our in-house marketing team. Reporting to the Lead Designer, this role supports the creative execution of brand campaigns, member acquisition initiatives, new club openings, and field marketing programs across our corporate and franchise network. This is a hands-on production and design role â ideal for a creative who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes direction well, and is excited to grow within a globally recognized fitness brand.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Design & Production

  • Create original graphic designs supporting company initiatives, including promotions, member acquisition campaigns, events, partnerships, and internal communications
  • Take approved concepts and designs from the Lead Designer and scale a single design across multiple formats, sizes, and channels (digital display, social, email, in-club signage, print collateral)
  • Ensure all creative output adheres to UFC GYM brand standards, templates, and style guidelines
  • Prepare print-ready and web-optimized files with accurate specs, bleeds, and color profiles


New Club Openings & Remodels

  • Develop and execute gym graphics plans for new club openings and remodels, including wall graphics, wayfinding, window clings, and environmental branding
  • Coordinate with vendors, printers, and field teams to ensure accurate production and installation of location graphics


Asset Management

  • Upload, organize, and maintain creative assets within the company's asset management platform, ensuring files are current, properly named, and accessible to corporate and franchise stakeholders
  • Support the marketing team in fulfilling creative asset requests from franchise locations and field teams


Team Support

  • Participate in creative briefings, provide production timelines, and manage multiple concurrent projects against deadlines
  • Support photo and video needs for events, club openings, and content capture as needed


Required Qualifications

  • 1â3 years of graphic design experience (agency, in-house, or strong portfolio of freelance/academic work)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (CC)
  • Proficiency in Canva and Figma
  • Experience working with Dropbox or similar cloud-based file management systems
  • Strong understanding of design fundamentals: typography, layout, hierarchy, and color
  • Ability to work within an established brand system and follow creative direction
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities
  • Portfolio required with application


Preferred Qualifications

  • Photography, videography, and video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or equivalent) â highly preferred
  • Experience with large-format print production and environmental graphics
  • Familiarity with fitness, sports, or lifestyle brands
  • Experience supporting multi-location or franchise organizations
  • Motion graphics or animation experience


Benefits

  • Full-time position with benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Complimentary UFC GYM membership
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Growth opportunity within a global fitness brand


We empower the fighting spirit in you!

This is a remote position.

This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to UFC Gym.

title: Vice President Field Services
description:
Who we areâ¦

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 10,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

â¯

What you'll be doingâ¦

As Vice President, Field Services, you will be a visionary and strategic leader responsible for orchestrating the success of our North American Field Services organization. You will oversee regional field operations, the Remote Technical Support Team (Command Center) department, Fleet Management, driving operational excellence, innovation, and scalability across a complex network of internal teams and third-party partners. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of field services, balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution. Your leadership will be essential in transforming operations through data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and a relentless focus on customer experience and cost control.

â¯

  • Lead and evolve the Field Services organization, including internal teams and third-party vendors, to deliver consistent, high-quality service across the U.S. and Canada.
  • Oversee Command Center operations to ensure real-time monitoring, incident response, problem management, and service continuity.
  • Direct Fleet Management strategy, optimizing asset utilization, maintenance, and lifecycle planning.
  • Manage multiple operational P&Ls, including forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking.
  • Champion a customer-focused culture and lead change management initiatives that align with enterprise goals.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans across people, processes, and technology to support growth and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve operational challenges, improve service delivery, and enhance field technician support.
  • Apply continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma to streamline processes and reduce defects.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and use data analytics to drive decision-making and operational enhancements.
  • Represent Field Services in executive forums, contributing to enterprise-wide strategy and planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What we're looking forâ¦

You are a visionary and strategic leader with a proven ability to scale and transform complex operations while driving service excellence across diverse teams and geographies. You bring a strong command of operational strategy, financial acumen, and performance management, paired with a deep understanding of field services, command center operations, and fleet management. Your communication skills enable you to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, while your analytical mindset supports data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. You thrive in dynamic environments, lead through change with confidence, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and customer focus.



You'll need to have:

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 7+ years of experience leading Field Services operations
  • 7+ years of experience leading Remote Technical Support (Command Center) operations
  • 2+ years of experience leading Fleet Management operations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams across North America or globally.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide initiatives at the executive level, including demonstrated skills ranging from work direction, motivation, coaching/feedback, and developing assigned staff with the expected outcome of consistently positive client experience and SLA attainment.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, ability to take the initiative, use good judgment, demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and follow-up, and carry multiple projects through to completion.
  • Qualified candidates will possess exceptional statistical/analytical skills, exemplary problem-solving abilities, and show initiative to get ahead of potential out-of-compliance processes .
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining good internal and external working relationships.
  • Demonstrated business process engineering/re-engineering experience using Six Sigma, Lean, or other formal process improvement methodology.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills, including a collaborative management style.

â¯

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • MBA or Master's in Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • Lean Six Sigma Training and Certification (Green belt or Black belt)
  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • ITIL4 Certification
  • Experience in the photo enforcement industry

â¯

Where you'll be workingâ¦



In this remote role, you'll have the flexibility to work from home full-time, allowing you to create an optimal work environment. You'll also have regular check-ins and team meetings scheduled through virtual platforms to ensure collaboration and support. This role requires up to 50% travel across North America to engage with teams, oversee operations, and support strategic initiatives.

Aligned with Verra Mobility Values

  • Do What's Right â We've committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers â integrity is our DNA
  • Lead With Grace â We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace.
  • Own It â We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice.
  • Win Together â We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together.



Verra Mobility Values



An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.

Company Overview

At Au Vodka, we pride ourselves on being a luxury vodka brand that embodies sophistication, innovation, and craftsmanship. Our premium product range offers a distinctive taste experience, wrapped in a bottle that is as luxurious as the spirit inside. With a strong focus on quality, exclusivity, and premium service, we are growing rapidly in the UK and international markets.

As a brand that truly understands what it means to stand out, we're looking for a passionate and dynamic National Account Manager to drive the next phase of growth and further establish Au Vodka within the wholesale and on-trade sectors.

About Au Vodka

Au Vodka isnât just a drinks brand, itâs a movement.

Born in Wales and recognised globally, weâve redefined what a modern FMCG brand can be. From our iconic gold bottles to boundary-pushing flavours, weâve built a brand that stands out, scales fast, and connects with a new generation of consumers.

Already sold across multiple international markets, weâre not just part of the spirits industry, weâre disrupting it.

Role Overview

The National Account Manager will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with the UK's leading national pub companies and key leisure accounts. The primary goal is to secure new business, grow existing partnerships, and maximise distribution, visibility and rate of sale across national managed estates. description:
Human Business Partner â Remote

Reports To: Senior Director of Human Resources

Cardiovascular Services of America (CVAUSA) is the largest private and independent cardiology network in the United States. Our inclusive and diverse network brings together top cardiovascular specialists and thought leaders who offer regional perspectives and a broad strategic vision for the future of patient care.

Who We are and what we do:
Â Â 
Headquartered in Orlando area, Cardiovascular Associates of America aims to bring the best cardiovascular physicians in one network with the common mission of saving lives, reducing costs, and improving patient care through clinical innovation. Through CVAUSAâs physician-centered practice management model, physicians drive clinical care and their practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise and shared resources available through CVAUSA for better patient outcomes.

Position Summary
The Human Resources Manager serves as a trusted HR partner supporting the National Services Organization (NSO) and a network of independent physician practices in a multi-site healthcare environment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Human Resources, this role is responsible for providing practical HR guidance with a strong focus on employee relations, talent acquisition, and leadership support while ensuring consistent HR practices across a growing organization.

This position is ideal for an experienced HR professional who enjoys balancing strategic partnership with hands-on execution. The HR Manager works closely with physicians, practice administrators, operational leaders, and corporate stakeholders to address employee concerns, support organizational growth, recruit top talent, and foster positive workplace cultures while respecting the unique identity of each practice.

Success in this role requires sound judgment, exceptional relationship-building skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving organization.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Employee Relations & HR Partnership
Â 
  • Serve as the primary HR partner to assigned business leaders, physicians, and practice administrators, providing practical guidance on employee relations, performance management, organizational policies, and HR best practices.
  • Handle employee relations matters from initial intake through resolution, including conducting workplace investigations, documenting findings, and recommending appropriate corrective actions.
  • Coach leaders through difficult conversations, performance concerns, conflict resolution, employee engagement, and policy interpretation.
  • Balance employee advocacy with sound business judgment while minimizing organizational risk.
  • Identify employee relations trends and recommend proactive solutions to strengthen leadership effectiveness, improve retention, and enhance workplace culture.
  • Build trusted relationships with leaders across multiple locations while supporting the unique culture of each independent practice.
Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning
  • Partner with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop recruiting strategies for clinical, administrative, and corporate positions.
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer coordination, and hiring.
  • Collaborate with recruiting resources and hiring leaders to improve candidate experience and reduce time-to-fill.
  • Coordinate and support onboarding to ensure new employees successfully integrate into both the organization and their individual practice culture.
  • Assist leadership with workforce planning to support organizational growth, expansion, and acquisitions.
HR Operations & Organizational Support
  • Provide day-to-day HR support to assigned practices and NSO leaders.
  • Support organizational growth initiatives, including onboarding new practices and assisting with HR integration efforts.
  • Assist in developing scalable HR policies, procedures, and best practices that support a decentralized operating model.
  • Partner with Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, Compliance, and Operations to ensure a consistent and positive employee experience.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, company policies, and regulatory requirements.
Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness
  • Build credibility and trusted partnerships with leaders at all levels of the organization.
  • Support organizational change initiatives through effective communication, coaching, and employee support.
  • Use data, sound judgment, and business insight to help leaders make informed workforce decisions.
  • Participate in HR initiatives that improve employee engagement, retention, leadership capability, and operational effectiveness.
Travel
  • Travel up to 20% to partner practices and regional locations to provide on-site HR support, conduct investigations, facilitate training, and strengthen relationships with practice leadership.
Qualifications

Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
Experience
  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience.
  • Experience supporting multiple locations or business units preferred.
  • Previous experience in healthcare, physician practice management, National Services Organizations (NSOs), or similarly complex environments is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing employee relations matters and conducting workplace investigations.
  • Hands-on full-cycle recruiting experience required.
Preferred Certifications
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification preferred.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The ideal candidate will:
Â 
  • Demonstrate strong expertise in employee relations and conflict resolution.
  • Think strategically while remaining willing to execute day-to-day HR responsibilities.
  • Build strong relationships and credibility with leaders across the organization.
  • Effectively coach managers on performance management, employee development, and workplace concerns.
  • Possess strong recruiting skills with the ability to identify and attract high-quality talent.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment where priorities evolve quickly.
  • Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential information.
  • Demonstrate exceptional communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Successfully manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
Working Conditions
  • Work is primarily performed in a professional office or remote office environment free from excessive noise and distractions.
  • Work area must ensure confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
  • Regular use of computers, telephones, and standard office equipment.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and move throughout the workday.
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for keyboarding and other office tasks.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through speaking, listening, and reading.
  • Occasional reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, or move up to 10 pounds on an occasional basis.
Equal Employment Opportunity
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an environment that promotes equity, inclusion, and belonging.

description:
Editor

Accelerating life-changing solutions to global healthcare challenges is the vision that unites us through a shared sense of purpose, whatever the role.

It speaks of the significant challenges that exist within global healthcare, and how we, as one team, can help to deliver better solutions and outcomes for our partners and for patients everywhere, sooner.

Through a pioneering fusion of the finest expertise in science, strategy, evidence, technology and creativity we deliver the world-class outcomes that our global partners trust to achieve their goals.

It speaks about collaboration and everyone's responsibility to bring together the diverse expertise that exists across our team to deliver world-class outcomes.

On this foundation, we have defined four core values, these represent the shared principles that guide our behaviors every day, whatever your role:

Be Brave, Be Human, Be Passionate, Be Exceptional.

At Prime these values are integral to who we are. They are there to guide you in your role and support you on your personal journey to success. They shape our culture and support us in achieving our vision together, as one global team.

The Role

Our Editors review and edit a wide range of content outputs (including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slides, PDFs, and digital materials) for grammar, spelling, consistency, and clarity while ensuring alignment with house, client and journal style guides. They apply consistent and appropriate use of digital markup tools, tracked changes and comments to provide clear, actionable editorial feedback.

They contribute to effective and timely project delivery by performing dummy submissions, ensuring the team is aware of specific requirements related to journal and congress guidelines. They proactively communicate and collaborate with internal teams to ensure best practices are being followed.

The right candidate will have impeccable English spelling, punctuation and grammar skills, and will display meticulous attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviewing and editing a wide range of content outputs (including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slides, PDFs, digital materials) for grammar, spelling, consistency, and clarity.
  • Ensuring alignment with house, client and journal style guides.
  • Applying consistent and appropriate use of digital markup tools, tracking changes and comments to provide clear, actionable editorial feedback.
  • Proofing typeset copy to include consideration of layout (figures/tables, colors, size, quality, and resolution) and liaise with studio and/or journal for necessary amends.
  • Checking redrawn figures, PowerPoint and PDFs from studio to ensure accuracy versus submitted materials.
  • Working with the teams to ensure all required copyright and author permissions are in place, and the relevant copyright wording is included for reproduced materials.
  • Owning and updating client style guides; ensures consistent application across accounts
  • Verifying content for scientific accuracy and consistency by verifying data, references, and source materials in line with SOPs.
  • Collaborating with the scientific team to resolve data discrepancies or uncertainties.
  • Escalating concerns or unclear data to relevant team members to ensure final outputs meet Prime quality standards.
  • Recording and monitoring actual vs. budgeted time on projects and completing timesheets accurately each week, submitting by the deadline.
  • Proactively flagging when task scope, timelines, or budgets are misaligned.

  • Highest standards of English spelling, punctuation, and grammar
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Solutions-focused, sound judgement and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to effectively work in a fast-paced agency setting
  • Strong multi-tasking, planning and organizational skills
  • Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Acrobat, EndNote, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint
  • Experience with digital markup, tracked changes, and editing tools
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Openness to learning, feedback and career development

Benefits

  • Supplemental medical, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Competitive salary
  • Generous time off
  • Pension
  • 401k Plan with match
  • Health & Wellbeing offerings
  • Job training and advancement opportunities

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company â it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

About the role

LifeMD is seeking a strategic, data-obsessed Director of Customer Experience to lead and elevate our remote customer operations. This role sits at the intersection of technology, clinical empathy, and operational excellence. We are looking for someone who has built and continuously evolved high-performing, technology-enabled CX organizations; deploying AI voice and chat tools, engineering data-driven performance cultures, and creating differentiated, concierge-level experiences that drive loyalty and growth.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience, you will translate the executive team's vision and strategy into operational reality,surfacing the voice of the customer, driving measurable performance, and partnering cross-functionally to embed customer insights into decisions across the organization. If you thrive in fast-moving health tech environments and believe exceptional customer experience is a commercial advantage, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Remote Contact Center Leadership

  • Lead, scale, and continuously optimize a remote contact center team across multiple channels (voice, chat, email, SMS). Setting KPIs, driving performance expectations, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Set and enforce service level standards, workforce management practices, scheduling, capacity models, and escalation protocols
  • Build a high-accountability, coaching-first culture across team leads and frontline agents

Customer Experience

  • Develop and maintain service blueprints and experience standards across contact and service touchpoints that transform support from a transactional function into a driver of loyalty and advocacy
  • Champion a culture of empathy, accountability, and customer-centricity across the entire CX organization

AI & Technology Integration

  • Own the performance of AI-powered support functions including AI voice (conversational IVR), chatbots, and agent-assist tools â monitoring deflection rates, containment quality, sentiment signals, and escalation patterns
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate, implement, and iterate on AI tooling that augments agent performance and improves resolution rates without sacrificing human connection
  • Ensure deep integration between CX technology and broader customer-facing platforms including EHR, CRM, and marketing automation systems
  • â¢ Stay current on emerging customer support technologies and serve as the internal subject matter expert on responsible AI use within a healthcare context

Data-Driven Performance Management

  • Define, track, and improve core CX metrics: first contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, NPS, escalation rate, AI containment rate, retention, and reactivation
  • Monitor NPS trends surfaced through the CX function and partner with the Manager of Patient Experience to close the loop on customer feedback and drive operational improvements
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting cadences that provide real-time operational visibility to your team and to the SVP
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance gaps and translate findings into structured improvement plans
  • Synthesize customer insights, VOC data, and operational trends into clear, executive-ready briefings

Commercial Impact & Customer Lifecycle

  • Align CX operations with revenue and retention goals, connecting CSAT, NPS, and resolution metrics to commercial outcomes including retention, upsell conversion, and reactivation
  • Identify patterns in customer friction that represent risk to renewal, referral, or acquisition, and advocate for fixes cross-functionally
  • Support onboarding and activation workflows that reduce time-to-value; contribute to behavioral engagement and churn prediction strategies

Quality Assurance

  • Design and maintain a rigorous QA framework covering interaction quality, compliance, empathy standards, and clinical accuracy
  • Establish calibration processes across QA reviewers to ensure scoring consistency and fairness
  • Use QA insights to inform targeted coaching, training curricula, and process improvement

Budget Management

  • Manage the CX department budget within parameters, including headcount planning, vendor contracts, and technology spend
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising service quality or customer outcomes; present trade-off analyses and recommendations

Remote Transition & Operational Build-Out

  • Lead the operational transition to a fully remote customer service model, owning the end-to-end migration across people, process, technology, and compliance workstreams
  • Partner with HR, IT, Legal, and Operations to execute the transition with minimal disruption to the customer experience, establishing remote workforce policies and tooling standards
  • Use the transition as an opportunity to redesign foundational processes and eliminate legacy inefficiencies

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of managers, team leads, QA specialists, trainers, and agents
  • Build workforce planning, career pathing, and succession pipelines within the CX organization
  • Design the management rhythms, coaching frameworks, and recognition programs that attract and retain top talent in a fully remote environment

Cross-Functional Partnership & Internal Alignment

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the Manager of Patient Experience, ensuring alignment between customer-facing service operations and the broader patient experience program
  • Collaborate closely with the Manager of Patient Experience to align on messaging touchpoints, technology integrations, and shared data â recognizing that the customer journey spans both functions and requires active coordination to deliver a coherent experience
  • Support the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience in executing the overall CX vision, roadmap, and resource planning
  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to embed the customer perspective in upstream decisions
  • Prepare structured insights, trend analyses, and investment recommendations for the SVP to carry into executive forums

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive CX, contact center, or customer operations leadership experience, with direct people management responsibility
  • Demonstrated experience leading remote or distributed teams of 50 or more across multiple channels and functions
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing AI/automation in a customer service context (chatbots, conversational IVR, agent-assist tools)
  • Strong analytical skills â comfortable building dashboards, interpreting performance data, and translating insights into operational action
  • Proven track record connecting CX performance to commercial outcomes including retention, reactivation, and revenue
  • Experience managing vendor relationships including BPO partners and technology providers
  • Experience building or maturing QA programs in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a department budget, including headcount, vendor, and technology spend

Preferred

  • Background in health tech, digital health, telehealth, or healthcare services
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements as they apply to CX operations, technology platforms, and data handling
  • Experience with platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Five9, Genesys, or similar CRM/WFM tools
  • Exposure to customer and patient experience frameworks (e.g., service blueprinting, NPS program design, churn prediction models)
  • Background in a direct-to-consumer or subscription-based business where CX plays a direct role in lifetime value

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plans
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Flexible PTO Policy
  • Paid Holidays
  • Short Term Disability
  • Training & Development

title: Creative Director
description:
About The Opportunity

LMG Staffing Solutions is partnering with a collaborative, design-driven digital agency to identify a Creative Director for a contract opportunity based in Philadelphia.

This role brings together brand strategy, creative leadership, and digital expertise to help clients solve complex business challenges through compelling, human-centered experiences. You will lead the strategic and creative vision across a diverse portfolio that may include healthcare, higher education, enterprise organizations, and emerging brands.

The ideal candidate can guide engagements from discovery through execution, lead multidisciplinary teams, strengthen creative quality, and connect creative recommendations to measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Strategic Brand Leadership

  • Lead the development of brand strategies, positioning, messaging frameworks, and digital experience recommendations
  • Connect strategic and creative recommendations to client goals, audience insights, and business objectives
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder workshops, and strategic planning engagements
  • Translate research and business insights into compelling brand narratives, messaging platforms, and customer experience strategies
  • Identify opportunities across marketing, digital experiences, products, and services
  • Partner with client services teams to align recommendations with client priorities, budgets, and long-term goals

Creative Leadership

  • Establish the strategic and creative vision for client engagements
  • Develop creative briefs with clear direction, measurable objectives, and actionable guidance
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across branding, web, UX/UI, content, digital marketing, and campaign development
  • Provide thoughtful creative direction and feedback that strengthens ideas and maintains brand integrity
  • Ensure work is strategically grounded, human-centered, and aligned with business outcomes
  • Mentor designers, writers, strategists, and other creative team members
  • Help foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing creative culture

Client Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Present creative concepts, brand strategies, and campaign recommendations with confidence
  • Facilitate conversations that connect business goals with creative opportunities
  • Build alignment across client stakeholders and internal teams
  • Collaborate with account and project management teams to support successful delivery while protecting strategic and creative integrity

Research & Strategic Planning

  • Lead stakeholder interviews, audience research, competitive analysis, surveys, and workshop facilitation
  • Synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and executive-ready presentations
  • Apply design thinking and human-centered problem-solving to uncover meaningful insights
  • Monitor trends in branding, customer behavior, digital experiences, marketing, technology, and AI-enabled solutions
  • Contribute strategic and creative thinking to new business opportunities

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading brand, digital, or integrated creative initiatives within an agency or consulting environment
  • Proven experience developing brand strategies, creative campaigns, digital experiences, and integrated marketing initiatives
  • Strong understanding of branding, UX/UI, web design, digital marketing, content strategy, and customer experience
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across strategy, design, content, marketing, and technology
  • Exceptional storytelling, facilitation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to translate complex business challenges into simple, compelling creative solutions
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and facilitating strategic workshops
  • Strong understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including websites, CMS platforms, paid media, marketing automation, analytics, and emerging AI-enabled experiences
  • Collaborative leadership style grounded in curiosity, empathy, accountability, and continuous learning

Why This Role

  • Contract opportunity with a collaborative, design-driven agency
  • Lead strategic and creative work across diverse client engagements
  • Shape brand strategies, digital experiences, and integrated campaigns
  • Partner directly with executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Mentor multidisciplinary creative teams and elevate creative standards
  • Contribute to new business growth and agency thought leadership
  • Balance creative excellence with measurable business impact

If you are a strategic creative leader who enjoys building brands, guiding teams, and shaping digital experiences that move organizations forward, we would love to connect.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week.


The role

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety.


Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end.


What you will do

  • Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch.
  • Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed.
  • Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working.
  • Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent.
  • Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece.
  • General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client.


What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience
  • 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agency 
  • Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline
  • Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools
  • Familiar with project management software
  • A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased
  • A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed
  • Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup
  • Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time
  • Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig


Nice to have (not required)

  • SEO or AI search visibility experience
  • Experience with task managers like ClickUp


Who this is not for

This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks.


What you get

  • An hourly rate of $20 to $25 USD, based on your experience.
  • Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row seat to how a marketing agency runs
  • Real room to grow. As we grow, you grow, in both responsibility and pay

description:

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region â this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Â 

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

Â 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Â 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in India. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in India.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Â 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Administrative Data Entry File Clerk
description:
Dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining organized business operations, our company is seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Data Entry File Clerk to join our team. If you excel at managing records, entering data accurately, and working independently in a remote environment, this opportunity may be the perfect fit for you.

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining digital files, updating databases, organizing administrative records, and ensuring information is entered accurately and efficiently. Your attention to detail, reliability, and commitment to data accuracy will play an important role in supporting daily operations and helping our team stay organized and productive.

Â 

Key responsibilities:

Â 

Intake & indexing.

  • Receive files from shared inboxes, portals, internal ticketing tools, and cloud folders.
  • Confirm document type, required fields, signatures, and attachments.
  • Index each record using standard metadata (client/project ID, date, document category, version, region).

Â 

Document organization.

  • Apply standardized naming conventions and folder structures.
  • Convert formats when needed (PDF merge/split, image-to-PDF, compressing, version labeling).
  • Maintain controlled libraries (final vs draft vs archived), including retention tags.

Â 

Quality control

  • Perform daily spot checks for duplicates, misfiles, missing pages, and unreadable scans.
  • Flag exceptions and route them to the correct owner with clear notes.
  • Maintain error logs and contribute to process improvements that reduce rework.

Â 

Records governance & compliance

  • Handle sensitive records with strict access controls and confidentiality.
  • Follow retention schedules, legal hold instructions, and deletion/archival rules.
  • Support audits by pulling records quickly and documenting chain-of-custody steps.

Â 

Collaboration & communication.

Coordinate with HR, Finance, Operations, Legal, or Customer teams to clarify file requirements.

Provide status updates on backlog, turnaround time, and issues found during processing.

Â 

Tools you may use:

Â 

  • Cloud storage (Google Drive/SharePoint/Dropbox), document tools (Adobe Acrobat or equivalents), spreadsheets, ticketing (Jira/Asana/ServiceNow), e-signature platforms, and basic office productivity tools.
  • Success metrics (examples):
  • Accuracy rate (misfile/metadata error rate)
  • Turnaround time from receipt to filed
  • Backlog size and daily throughput
  • Audit retrieval speed and completeness
  • Compliance adherence (access control, retention tagging)

Â 

Qualifications:

Â 

  • Experience in records management, admin support, clerical work, or document control (preferred).
  • Strong attention to detail; able to follow naming/filing rules consistently.
  • Comfortable handling confidential information and following strict procedures.
  • Basic computer proficiency: file systems, spreadsheets, PDFs, and collaboration tools.

title: Prozessentwickler, Prozessoptimierer - mit KI (m/w/d)
description:
Business Automation Specialist

Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Automatisierung mit echtem Impact

Worum es geht

Du suchst mehr als Routine?

Bei kalkül arbeitest du digital, eigenverantwortlich und echt mandantenorientiert im Team, das sich gegenseitig stärkt.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 1–2 Tage Homeoffice

  • Weiterbildung und persönliches Wachstum

  • Modernes, digitales Arbeiten

Deine Aufgaben

  • eigenständige Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automatisierungen und internen Apps

  • Nutzung von KI-Tools, vor allem Claude Code (sehr intensiv), um effizient zu coden, zu testen und zu deployen – Agentic Coding

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Workflows – z. B. eigene Apps & APIs, mit Claude Code entwickelt

  • Analyse bestehender Arbeitsprozesse und Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen

  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen

  • iterative Verbesserung bestehender Lösungen und Apps

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein Arbeitsplatz, an dem es vorwärts geht – Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten von Tag eins – mit schnellem, stufenartigem Onboarding in 4 Wochen.

  • Ein geiles Team – mit einer geilen Vision, das vorankommen will – inklusive Team-Events wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Wandertag sowie Lobesrunde mit Team und Geschäftsführung.

  • Gehalt, das mitzieht – 13. Gehalt bei Zielerreichung und betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Extra-Zuschuss.

  • Gesundheit & Extras – 600 Euro Gesundheitsbudget pro Jahr – dazu Jobrad, Kaffee-Flat, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss und mehr.

  • Weiterbildung, die bezahlt wird – Bezahlte Weiterbildungen & Schulungen – dein Wissen wird bei uns aktiv gefördert.

  • Flexibel arbeiten – Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 1–2 Tage Homeoffice in der Woche möglich.

Was du wissen solltest

Geschwindigkeit ist unsere Kultur. Du kannst von uns erwarten, dass du schneller eine Rückmeldung erhältst als bei jedem anderen Arbeitgeber, bei dem du dich beworben hast – und dass du im Job alles bekommst, was du brauchst, um maximal schnell die belohnenden Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit zu sehen. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir von dir, dass du Geschwindigkeit liebst, es dich begeistert, dich immer weiter selbst zu optimieren, und es dich glücklich macht, wenn du das Unternehmen noch schneller voranbringen kannst.

Volle Fahrt voraus! 🏴‍☠️⚔️

Wie sieht dein Bewerbungsprozess aus?

1️⃣ Schnelle Rückmeldung: Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden eine persönliche Antwort – wir lassen dich nicht warten.

2️⃣ Telefoninterview: Ein kurzes, lockeres Telefonat – wir klären die wichtigsten Fragen auf beiden Seiten, ganz ohne Anfahrt.

3️⃣ Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du kommst zu uns nach Dresden und lernst die Geschäftsleitung und dein zukünftiges Umfeld kennen. Hier zählt Persönlichkeit – kein standardisiertes Fragebogen-Gespräch.

4️⃣ Dein Schnuppertag: Erlebe uns live – Team, Kultur und Arbeitsweise. Du bekommst einen echten Einblick in deinen zukünftigen Arbeitsplatz.

✅ Willkommen im Team: Wenn für beide Seiten alles passt, unterschreibst du deinen Vertrag – und startest schon bald bei uns.

Du passt nicht zu 100 %? – Bewirb dich trotzdem!

Was soll schon passieren? Ein „Nein“ hast du ja schon – wenn du dich nicht beworben hast. Auch Quereinsteiger sind hier herzlich willkommen. Was zählt, ist, wie du drauf bist – und nicht, was auf deinem Zeugnis, deinem Lebenslauf oder einem Zertifikat steht.



Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Automatisierung und ein gutes Verständnis für Prozesse und Abläufe im Unternehmensalltag.

  • Du arbeitest sehr analytisch, hands-on und lösungsorientiert. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und eigenverantwortlich und willst aktiv Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse übernehmen.

  • Digitale Arbeitsweisen und moderne Prozesse interessieren dich. Du bist offen für neue Tools und experimentelles Arbeiten.

  • Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Du hast schon Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder ähnlichen Coding-Agenten.

Du bist hier falsch, wenn …

  • Du eigentlich nur einen 9-to-5-Job suchst, um irgendwas zu haben.

  • Du keine Verantwortung übernehmen willst – und lieber möchtest, dass jemand anderes für deine Ergebnisse verantwortlich ist.

  • Du denkst, du könntest es eh besser als die KI – und willst deswegen nochmal überall „drüberlesen“.

  • Du von uns „KI-Schulungen“ willst, damit du leisten kannst. Ja, wir geben dir Wissen. Aber Lernen ist auch eine Holschuld – wenn du nicht bereit bist, dir dein Wissen selbst zu holen, bist du hier falsch.

About the position

As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will:

  • Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
  • Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
  • Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
  • Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
  • Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
  • Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
  • Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
  • Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
  • Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
  • Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.

  • Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  

You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:

We are a product-driven organization building technology that unlocks the value in video and image data without compromising the people it captures. As part of Milestone Systems, we bring together anonymization and responsibly sourced, fully traceable video data with specialized AI models across our product portfolio. We are seeking an ambitious Product Manager driven by customer satisfaction, product success, and opportunities for growth. You will work with customers, commercial and development teams, and senior management to align on a product vision, define a roadmap, and bring stakeholders together to continuously develop our product strategy. If you understand the software-as-a-service business model and AI and computer-vision technologies, this role is for you. You must have a passion for great customer experiences paired with strong product skills. This is what will make you successful in this role.

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • You will define a product vision together with the Director of Product andthe product team, set strategic priorities, and translate this vision into a product roadmap supported by meaningful KPIs.
  • You will approach customers and stakeholders with genuine curiosity and translate these insights into ideas and actions that delight them.
  • You will act as the strategic link between product vision and technical execution and be responsible for product ownership across the development teams.
  • You will identify opportunities for new products and product improvements byresearching markets and interacting with customers, potential customers, and partners.
  • You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders such as tech development and support teams, sales, and senior management to shape and drive the product agenda.

IN ORDER FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU BRING:

  • You have 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager in a technical environment or a comparable position, ideally in B2B SaaS, artificial intelligence, or both.
  • You have strong skills in defining product, product vision, and product family strategy.
  • You are an effective product advocate who communicates clearly with stakeholders at every level and ensures that feedback from customers and internal teams directly influences product development.
  • You have a good understanding of software-as-a-service business models.
  • You are a self-starting leader, detail-oriented, process-oriented, and organized.
  • You are fluent in written and spoken English.

ALSO DESIRABLE:

  • Your experience with products in computer vision, AI, or video management domains is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Friendly cooperation at eye level - We live and breathe flat hierarchies with a positive feedback culture.
  • Innovation where it matters - A challenging position in a company that is changing the world of video data: With you we will make history.
  • Creative and entrepreneurial playground - Get a chance to be your own master, define your own tasks, actively contribute and implement your ideas. Grow yourself and grow the success of the company with direct influence from day one.
  • Team spirit celebrates diversity - Numerous events to get to know the teams and meet our great visionaries.
  • Flexible working hours - Trust-based and goal-oriented working culture.
  • Benefits to smooth your ride in life - Public transport ticket with a 50% subsidy and a huge discount on Urban Sports Club memberships.
  • Boost your learning – we’ll fund it - We offer a generous learning budget so you can improve your skills.
  • Loft-office in central Berlin - With free drinks and a large balcony with barbecue.

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE:

We are a diverse, ambitious team with a great passion for data privacy, generative AI and startups. Our office is in the heart of Berlin, one of the coolest, most vibrant cities worldwide. We enjoy teamwork and celebrating successes together. If you are looking for a new challenge with real impact from day one, check out our job openings and apply today!
